description: This file is the main entry point for running the ProtocolandCodingService application. It provides environment-based configuration for host and port, and launches the Uvicorn server to serve an ASGI application specified as 'app.main:app'. It also handles errors related to missing dependencies and clean shutdown signals.

methods.name: tuple[str,int] resolve_host_port()
methods.description: Resolves the HOST and PORT environment variables with defaults, converting PORT to an integer and providing fallback defaults if the environment variables are invalid or missing.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that starts the uvicorn server with configured host and port, handling missing uvicorn dependencies and keyboard interrupts.
